1→defmodule TestPhoenixProject.Blog.PostRepository do
     2→  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
     3→  alias TestPhoenixProject.Repo
     4→
     5→  alias TestPhoenixProject.Blog.Post
     6→  alias TestPhoenixProject.Accounts.Scope
     7→
     8→  @doc """
     9→  Returns the list of posts.
    10→
    11→  ## Examples
    12→
    13→      iex> list_posts(scope)
    14→      [%Post{}, ...]
    15→
    16→  """
    17→  def list_posts(%Scope{} = scope) do
    18→    Repo.all_by(Post, user_id: scope.user.id)
    19→  end
    20→
    21→  @doc """
    22→  Gets a single post.
    23→
    24→  Raises `Ecto.NoResultsError` if the Post does not exist.
    25→
    26→  ## Examples
    27→
    28→      iex> get_post!(scope, 123)
    29→      %Post{}
    30→
    31→      iex> get_post!(scope, 456)
    32→      ** (Ecto.NoResultsError)
    33→
    34→  """
    35→  def get_post!(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
    36→    Repo.get_by!(Post, id: id, user_id: scope.user.id)
    37→  end
    38→
    39→  @doc """
    40→  Creates a post.
    41→
    42→  ## Examples
    43→
    44→      iex> create_post(scope, %{field: value})
    45→      {:ok, %Post{}}
    46→
    47→      iex> create_post(scope, %{field: bad_value})
    48→      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
    49→
    50→  """
    51→  def create_post(%Scope{} = scope, attrs) do
    52→    %Post{}
    53→    |> Post.changeset(attrs, scope)
    54→    |> Repo.insert()
    55→  end
    56→
    57→  @doc """
    58→  Updates a post.
    59→
    60→  ## Examples
    61→
    62→      iex> update_post(scope, post, %{field: new_value})
    63→      {:ok, %Post{}}
    64→
    65→      iex> update_post(scope, post, %{field: bad_value})
    66→      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
    67→
    68→  """
    69→  def update_post(%Scope{} = scope, %Post{} = post, attrs) do
    70→    true = post.user_id == scope.user.id
    71→
    72→    post
    73→    |> Post.changeset(attrs, scope)
    74→    |> Repo.update()
    75→  end
    76→
    77→  @doc """
    78→  Deletes a post.
    79→
    80→  ## Examples
    81→
    82→      iex> delete_post(scope, post)
    83→      {:ok, %Post{}}
    84→
    85→      iex> delete_post(scope, post)
    86→      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}}
    87→
    88→  """
    89→  def delete_post(%Scope{} = scope, %Post{} = post) do
    90→    true = post.user_id == scope.user.id
    91→
    92→    Repo.delete(post)
    93→  end
    94→
    95→  @doc """
    96→  Returns an `%Ecto.Changeset{}` for tracking post changes.
    97→
    98→  ## Examples
    99→
   100→      iex> change_post(scope, post)
   101→      %Ecto.Changeset{data: %Post{}}
   102→
   103→  """
   104→  def change_post(%Scope{} = scope, %Post{} = post, attrs \\ %{}) do
   105→    true = post.user_id == scope.user.id
   106→
   107→    Post.changeset(post, attrs, scope)
   108→  end
   109→end
   110→

1→# TestPhoenixProject.Blog.PostRepository
     2→
     3→**Type**: logic
     4→
     5→Provides data access layer for blog posts with user-scoped security. All operations are filtered by user ownership to ensure users can only access their own posts.
     6→
     7→## Functions
     8→
     9→### list_posts/1
    10→
    11→Returns all posts owned by the scoped user.
    12→
    13→```elixir
    14→@spec list_posts(Scope.t()) :: [Post.t()]
    15→```
    16→
    17→**Process**:
    18→1. Query posts filtering by user_id from scope
    19→2. Return all matching posts
    20→
    21→**Test Assertions**:
    22→- returns all posts for scoped user
    23→- returns empty list when user has no posts
    24→- does not return posts from other users
    25→
    26→### get_post!/2
    27→
    28→Retrieves a single post by ID for the scoped user, raising if not found or not owned.
    29→
    30→```elixir
    31→@spec get_post!(Scope.t(), id :: integer()) :: Post.t()
    32→```
    33→
    34→**Process**:
    35→1. Query post by id and user_id from scope
    36→2. Raise Ecto.NoResultsError if not found
    37→3. Return the post
    38→
    39→**Test Assertions**:
    40→- returns post when found and owned by scoped user
    41→- raises Ecto.NoResultsError when post not found
    42→- raises Ecto.NoResultsError when post owned by different user
    43→
    44→### create_post/2
    45→
    46→Creates a new post with automatic user ownership assignment.
    47→
    48→```elixir
    49→@spec create_post(Scope.t(), attrs :: map()) :: {:ok, Post.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
    50→```
    51→
    52→**Process**:
    53→1. Build changeset with scope to set user_id
    54→2. Insert post into database
    55→3. Return {:ok, post} on success or {:error, changeset} on failure
    56→
    57→**Test Assertions**:
    58→- creates post with valid attributes
    59→- sets user_id from scope
    60→- returns error changeset for invalid attributes
    61→- validates required fields
    62→
    63→### update_post/3
    64→
    65→Updates an existing post after verifying ownership.
    66→
    67→```elixir
    68→@spec update_post(Scope.t(), Post.t(), attrs :: map()) :: {:ok, Post.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
    69→```
    70→
    71→**Process**:
    72→1. Verify post.user_id matches scope.user.id via pattern matching
    73→2. Build changeset with scope and attributes
    74→3. Update post in database
    75→4. Return {:ok, post} on success or {:error, changeset} on failure
    76→
    77→**Test Assertions**:
    78→- updates post with valid attributes
    79→- returns error changeset for invalid attributes
    80→- raises MatchError when user does not own post
    81→
    82→### delete_post/2
    83→
    84→Deletes a post after verifying ownership.
    85→
    86→```elixir
    87→@spec delete_post(Scope.t(), Post.t()) :: {:ok, Post.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
    88→```
    89→
    90→**Process**:
    91→1. Verify post.user_id matches scope.user.id via pattern matching
    92→2. Delete post from database
    93→3. Return {:ok, post} on success
    94→
    95→**Test Assertions**:
    96→- deletes post when user owns it
    97→- raises MatchError when user does not own post
    98→
    99→### change_post/3
   100→
   101→Returns a changeset for tracking post changes without persistence.
   102→
   103→```elixir
   104→@spec change_post(Scope.t(), Post.t(), attrs :: map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t()
   105→```
   106→
   107→**Process**:
   108→1. Build changeset with scope and attributes
   109→2. Return changeset for form generation and validation
   110→
   111→**Test Assertions**:
   112→- returns changeset for post
   113→- includes validation errors in changeset
   114→
   115→## Dependencies
   116→
   117→- TestPhoenixProject.Repo
   118→- post.spec.md
   119→- TestPhoenixProject.Accounts.Scope
   120→- Ecto.Query
   121→

     8→

    11→      refute Accounts.get_user_by_email("unknown@example.com")
    12→    end
    13→
    14→    test "returns the user if the email exists" do

    30→    test "returns the user if the email and password are valid" do

    45→    test "returns the user with the given id" do

    49→  end
    50→
    51→  describe "register_user/1" do
    52→    test "requires email to be set" do
    53→      {:error, changeset} = Accounts.register_user(%{})
    54→
    55→      assert %{email: ["can't be blank"]} = errors_on(changeset)

    57→
    58→    test "validates email when given" do
    59→      {:error, changeset} = Accounts.register_user(%{email: "not valid"})
    60→
    61→      assert %{email: ["must have the @ sign and no spaces"]} = errors_on(changeset)
    62→    end
    63→
    64→    test "validates maximum values for email for security" do
    65→      too_long = String.duplicate("db", 100)
    66→      {:error, changeset} = Accounts.register_user(%{email: too_long})
    67→      assert "should be at most 160 character(s)" in errors_on(changeset).email

    69→
    70→    test "validates email uniqueness" do

    72→      {:error, changeset} = Accounts.register_user(%{email: email})
    73→      assert "has already been taken" in errors_on(changeset).email
    74→
    75→      # Now try with the upper cased email too, to check that email case is ignored.
    76→      {:error, changeset} = Accounts.register_user(%{email: String.upcase(email)})
    77→      assert "has already been taken" in errors_on(changeset).email
    78→    end
    79→
    80→    test "registers users without password" do

    96→      refute Accounts.sudo_mode?(%User{authenticated_at: DateTime.add(now, -21, :minute)})
    97→
    98→      # minute override
    99→      refute Accounts.sudo_mode?(
   100→               %User{authenticated_at: DateTime.add(now, -11, :minute)},
   101→               -10
   102→             )
   103→

defmodule TestPhoenixProject.Blog.PostRepositoryTest do
  use TestPhoenixProject.DataCase, async: true

  alias TestPhoenixProject.Blog.PostRepository
  alias TestPhoenixProject.Blog.Post

  import TestPhoenixProject.AccountsFixtures, only: [user_scope_fixture: 0]
  import TestPhoenixProject.BlogFixtures

  @invalid_attrs %{title: nil, content: nil, published: nil}

  describe "list_posts/1" do
    test "returns all posts for scoped user" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post1 = post_fixture(scope)
      post2 = post_fixture(scope)
      assert PostRepository.list_posts(scope) == [post1, post2]
    end

    test "returns empty list when user has no posts" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      assert PostRepository.list_posts(scope) == []
    end

    test "does not return posts from other users" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      other_scope = user_scope_fixture()

      _post_for_scope = post_fixture(scope)
      _post_for_other = post_fixture(other_scope)

      posts = PostRepository.list_posts(scope)
      assert length(posts) == 1
      assert Enum.all?(posts, fn post -> post.user_id == scope.user.id end)
    end
  end

  describe "get_post!/2" do
    test "returns post when found and owned by scoped user" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)
      assert PostRepository.get_post!(scope, post.id) == post
    end

    test "raises Ecto.NoResultsError when post not found" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      assert_raise Ecto.NoResultsError, fn ->
        PostRepository.get_post!(scope, 999999)
      end
    end

    test "raises Ecto.NoResultsError when post owned by different user" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      other_scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(other_scope)

      assert_raise Ecto.NoResultsError, fn ->
        PostRepository.get_post!(scope, post.id)
      end
    end
  end

  describe "create_post/2" do
    test "creates post with valid attributes" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      valid_attrs = %{title: "some title", content: "some content", published: true}

      assert {:ok, %Post{} = post} = PostRepository.create_post(scope, valid_attrs)
      assert post.title == "some title"
      assert post.content == "some content"
      assert post.published == true
    end

    test "sets user_id from scope" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      valid_attrs = %{title: "title", content: "content", published: true}

      assert {:ok, %Post{} = post} = PostRepository.create_post(scope, valid_attrs)
      assert post.user_id == scope.user.id
    end

    test "returns error changeset for invalid attributes" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      assert {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}} = PostRepository.create_post(scope, @invalid_attrs)
    end

    test "validates required fields" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      {:error, changeset} = PostRepository.create_post(scope, %{})

      assert %{title: ["can't be blank"]} = errors_on(changeset)
    end
  end

  describe "update_post/3" do
    test "updates post with valid attributes" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)
      update_attrs = %{title: "updated title", content: "updated content"}

      assert {:ok, %Post{} = updated_post} = PostRepository.update_post(scope, post, update_attrs)
      assert updated_post.title == "updated title"
      assert updated_post.content == "updated content"
    end

    test "returns error changeset for invalid attributes" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)

      assert {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}} = PostRepository.update_post(scope, post, @invalid_attrs)
    end

    test "raises MatchError when user does not own post" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      other_scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(other_scope)

      assert_raise MatchError, fn ->
        PostRepository.update_post(scope, post, %{title: "new title"})
      end
    end
  end

  describe "delete_post/2" do
    test "deletes post when user owns it" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)

      assert {:ok, %Post{}} = PostRepository.delete_post(scope, post)
      assert_raise Ecto.NoResultsError, fn ->
        PostRepository.get_post!(scope, post.id)
      end
    end

    test "raises MatchError when user does not own post" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      other_scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(other_scope)

      assert_raise MatchError, fn ->
        PostRepository.delete_post(scope, post)
      end
    end
  end

  describe "change_post/3" do
    test "returns changeset for post" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)

      assert %Ecto.Changeset{} = PostRepository.change_post(scope, post)
    end

    test "includes validation errors in changeset" do
      scope = user_scope_fixture()
      post = post_fixture(scope)

      changeset = PostRepository.change_post(scope, post, @invalid_attrs)
      assert %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset
      refute changeset.valid?
    end
  end
end
